$description: Pi Pocket's own design system: Tokyo Night in dark, a light day mode, and a high-contrast mode.

com.pi-pocket.name: Pi Pocket
com.pi-pocket.description: The look of Pi Pocket: soft tiles over a Tokyo Night palette, Geist for words, JetBrains Mono for code.

neutral.$description: Blue-gray neutrals. 0 to 100 are light grounds, 300 to 500 dark-mode text, 600 to 950 dark grounds.

blue.$description: The accent. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

red.$description: Errors and danger. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

yellow.$description: Warnings. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

orange.$description: The brand mark. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

green.$description: Success. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

cyan.$description: Information and code operators. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

magenta.$description: Thinking and keywords. 300 is Tokyo Night's own value. 700 reads on light grounds and under white text.

alpha.$description: Overlays: the text color laid over a ground at a few percent, as the app does for hover, press, and hairlines.

scrim-dark.$description: Dim layer behind sheets, on dark grounds.

scrim-light.$description: Dim layer behind sheets, on light grounds.

surface.$description: Cards and panels on the ground.

raised.$description: Controls and anything lifted off a surface.

sunken.$description: Inset areas: code blocks and wells.

hover.$description: Overlay on a hovered row or button.

pressed.$description: Overlay on a pressed row or button.

scrim.$description: The dim layer behind a sheet.

primary.$description: Headings and the words that matter.

muted.$description: Hints, timestamps, and secondary labels. Reads at 4.5:1 on every ground, a selected row too.

inverse.$description: Text on a strong, neutral fill.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only. WCAG exempts disabled text from contrast, so it is below 4.5:1 on purpose: never use it for words that matter or for a placeholder.

subtle.$description: A hairline between tiles and rows.

default.$description: A visible line: cards and dividers.

strong.$description: The edge of a field or a switch track. Reaches 3:1 on every ground.

default.$description: Links, icons, and accents on a ground.

fill.$description: The fill of a primary button.

soft.$description: A quiet accent wash behind selected things.

line.$description: The border of an accent wash.

default.$description: Errors and destructive actions. Text and icons.

line.$description: The border of a danger message.

fill.$description: The fill of a destructive button.

fill-hover.$description: The destructive fill under the pointer.

default.$description: Warnings and cautions. Text and icons.

line.$description: The border of a warning message.

default.$description: Success and done. Text and icons.

line.$description: The border of a success message.

default.$description: Information and neutral notices. Text and icons.

line.$description: The border of an info message.

text.$description: Code without a color of its own.

mono.$description: Code, paths, branches, numbers, counts, and keys. Ligatures off, as in a terminal.

size.$description: The type scale, close to 1.125 above 14 px.

duration.$description: Hyprland's speeds, rounded to six steps.

z.$description: Stacking order of layers over the page.

hair.$description: A hairline of space: the padding of a badge, the offset of a focus ring.

radius.$description: Corners by what they round. Pills and avatars are round.

sheet.$description: The message box, sheets, the launcher.

float.$description: Pop-ups and menus. Equal to radius.sheet today; kept apart so that floating things can be rounded on their own.

tap.$description: The smallest touch target on a touch screen.

step-mark.$description: The mark of a step in an activity timeline.

breakpoint.$description: Minimum widths. Below md is the phone layout.

shadow.$description: Soft lifts. The shadow color follows the mode.

lift.$description: A soft lift: the message box.

float.$description: What floats over the page: pop-ups, sheets, the launcher.

hairline.$description: A 1 px outline drawn as a shadow, so layout does not move.

focus-ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring: a soft halo around a solid line. Keep it visible.

type.$description: Text styles. Each is one family, size, weight, line height, and tracking.

display.$description: Page titles and the home screen.

title.$description: A screen or a sheet title.

in-out.$description: Things that move across the screen.

notice.$description: A message that sits in the page.

menu.$description: Rows in a pop-up menu or a list.

step.$description: A step in an activity timeline.
